selection: 10 selectable families and 5 script fallback families, all shipped offline as original unmodified upstream binaries.
license: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-1.1); original copyright notices and licence texts retained per family. Font licensing is separate from the application licence.

retrieval.method: Selected files retrieved from official commit-pinned upstream raw URLs; no full Google Fonts or Noto repository clones. Local selected-file metadata cache inspected before selection. All SHA-256 values refer to original file bytes.

coverage_inspection.method: Read name, OS/2, and Unicode cmap tables from each exact bundled binary. TTFont.getBestCmap selects the preferred Unicode cmap. Ranges list encoded codepoints; script counts intersect Unicode blocks and do not imply every codepoint in a block is assigned or required. Probes record exact strings and missing codepoints. No rendering, shaping, app build, or test suite was run.

limitations: No single bundled typeface covers every language or all of Unicode. Glyph presence is not proof of complete language support, shaping correctness, or legibility on a 96-dot thermal print head.

Fallback covers representative Arabic, Hebrew (including the recorded niqqud sample), Devanagari, Thai, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Japanese kana/kanji, and Korean Hangul samples. Latin, Russian/Serbian Cyrillic, and Greek alphabet samples are covered by Noto Sans, Noto Serif, JetBrains Mono, and Press Start 2P.

UnifrakturMaguntia and Bungee do not cover the Russian alphabet; their selectors are labelled Latin. Missing script glyphs use normal fallback faces, not the selected decorative style. Shantell Sans is open-source comic-style handwriting, not proprietary Comic Sans.

The shared Noto Sans CJK KR face uses Korean regional Han glyph forms. It contains 44,810 encoded Unicode codepoints, not the entire CJK repertoire; rare or supplementary ideographs may be missing. Japanese and Chinese regional Han forms are not individually bundled.
No dedicated Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, Sinhala, Myanmar, Khmer, Ethiopic, or color-emoji face is bundled; do not advertise universal language or emoji coverage.

Noto Sans, Noto Serif, JetBrains Mono, and Shantell Sans include original regular, bold, italic, and bold-italic binaries. Other families have one normal 400 face; bold/italic requests may be synthesized by Flutter rather than authored variants.

The upstream JetBrains Mono Bold and Bold Italic files identify themselves as Bold but carry OS/2 usWeightClass 558. pubspec.yaml maps these authored Bold variants to Flutter weight 700 without modifying their original binaries; each file's weight field here preserves the actual OS/2 value.
